steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen, which starts with the default Auction stage.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Open the stage-addition menu from the plus control beside the stage tabs.
Assert that RFQ is not offered while Auction is present.
Hover the add-stage plus control to reveal the restriction explanation.
Assert the tooltip explains why RFQ cannot be added.
